title: 歌舞路ブルース
caption: Late 1960s Japanese kayo blues, slow and sultry, a nightclub torch song. A smoky, husky female alto singing in Japanese, bitter and proud, with a slow vibrato at the ends of phrases. Muted trumpet with a wah mute, sobbing tenor saxophone, tremolo electric guitar, upright bass, brushed drums with a slow triplet feel, soft strings. Weary, defiant, a hostess taking off her make-up as the neon goes out. Warm vintage studio sound with plate reverb.
lyrics:
